definitions.condition: Both upper/lower bands opening vs preceding completed parent, midpoint aligned with 15m side. No parent exposure requirement.
definitions.unknown: Missing preceding 20/21 parent closing minutes or official period continuity; never classified as weak.
definitions.observed: Containing parent at signal source minute, partial or just closed; 19 prior closes plus observed signal price.
definitions.last_closed: Last available completed parent, respecting official early/normal session close.
definitions.outcome: Underlying minute-close move from observed signal price, not options P&L or executable fill.
definitions.cohort: Complete 15-minute future, chronological period boundaries, no overlap within company/source. No 1m-band alignment gate.
